locales.note: First path segment treated as a locale variant (e.g. 'de' → /de and /de/about are variants of / and /about). Used by perf-check --full --worklist --only-failed to collapse locale variants in delta iterations: a failing page re-audits only its default-locale route; the full route set still runs at confirm. Leave empty for single-locale sites.

hosting.note: Asserted by perf-check.mjs --hosted <url> against the deployed URL (not the local static server).

agentic.note: llmsTxt: fast-path check of dist/llms.txt (exists + H1 + link + min length). The Lighthouse audits llms-txt + agent-accessibility-tree are gated at 1 in presets.*.assertions (LH 13.3+; older versions skip them as blind-spots). WebMCP audits and the agentic-browsing category score are intentionally NOT gated (experimental, pass-ratio semantics).

jsonld.note: Validated by perf-check.mjs against each route's built HTML (Lighthouse has no structured-data audit). Default = presence + validity (parses, schema.org @context). Opt-in strictness: perRoute e.g. { "/": { "types": ["WebSite", "Organization"] } }; requiredProps e.g. { "Article": ["headline", "author", "datePublished"] }. The fix-loop skill ratchets perRoute entries in as it fixes routes.

bundleBudget.note: Read by scripts/perf-check.mjs. NOTE: maxRouteJsKb is a SITE-TOTAL, not per-route — it sums every .js file in dist/_astro (gzipped), so React islands + GSAP chunks count even when no single route loads them all. Set it to the heaviest realistic route + headroom (120 is the showcase baseline). The 'presets' and 'collect' keys are also read by perf-check.mjs (not LHCI — LHCI is no longer used).

links.note: Internal link/asset checker (dist-based, fast + full modes): every root-absolute href/src in built HTML must resolve to a file in dist/. Closes the Lighthouse 13.x blind-spot (resource 404s are no longer flagged by errors-in-console). 'ignore' is an array of path prefixes to skip. Relative URLs are not checked (v1 scope).

meta.note: Per-route head-tag lint (dist-based, fast + full modes): title, meta[name=description], link[rel=canonical], meta[property=og:image]. Lighthouse has NO canonical or Open Graph audit. Set a key to false to skip that check.

imageBudget.note: Per-route total image weight in KB (raw bytes, dist-based, fast + full modes): sums every local image referenced by the route's built HTML — img src + first srcset candidate, CSS url() refs (inline styles AND linked local stylesheets — background-image heroes are counted), and link[rel=preload][as=image] hrefs. Hero images are the #1 perf killer on showcase sites — budget them at audit time, Chrome-free.
